correctness.rationale: On rho=(1+nu)m/(ph) with m=nu tau, h=1-exp(-m), kappa=1-exp(-(1+nu)tau), the 3x3 map linearization has simple center eigenvalue 1 and two transverse exp(-m)∈(0,1). Along center eigendirection (s1,a,r)=(Aa,a,Ra)+O(a²), direct Q(a) expansion gives adopter a’=a+c2 a²+O(a³), c2=kappa² Psi(p)/(p²h). Independently reproduced coefficient both from q1/q2 and closed Psi, p*≈0.4821344 when nu=.1,tau=1 and n a_n≈0.19434 versus predicted 0.19827 at n=100000 for p=.85. Analytically Psi strictly decreases from positive at p=0 to negative at 1, so unique p*. Center stable foliation yields local attraction when c2<0, relative instability when >0, and telescoped 1/a_n differences give asymptotic -1/c2. Critical equality p=p* unclaimed, p=1 invariant slice accommodated, no global basin. Finite simulation is only corroboration.
